language.title: Language Preference
language.description: Choose your preferred language for the app interface

finance.title: Pay Rates
finance.description: Set your daily pay rates. These will be used to calculate your weekly earnings.
finance.warning: These should only be changed on the week that pay rates change.
finance.sixDayBonusDescription: Flat £30 bonus for working 6 days per working week (Peak season only).
finance.invoicingDescription: Choose how you handle invoicing and tax returns. Costs are deducted from your weekly standard pay.
finance.selfInvoicingDescription: Handle your own invoicing and tax returns
finance.versoBasicDescription: Professional invoicing + public liability insurance (requires Ltd company)
finance.versoFullDescription: Full invoicing + accounting + tax returns + insurance (requires Ltd company)

user.title: Profile Information
user.description: Update your personal information. Display name is required, while first and last names are optional.
user.displayNameHelp: This is how you'll be identified in the app
user.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.description: Restart the onboarding wizard to see the setup process again or take the interactive dashboard tour.

restartDialog.title: Restart Onboarding
restartDialog.description: Choose how you'd like to restart the onboarding process
restartDialog.fullOnboardingDescription: Start completely fresh. This will delete all your entered data (work days, van hires, settings) and begin from scratch.
restartDialog.tourOnlyDescription: Keep your data and just view the interactive dashboard tour. Your real data won't be affected.
restartDialog.warningText: This action cannot be undone. All work days, van hires, and settings will be permanently deleted.

deleteAccount.permanentHeading: This action is PERMANENT and IRREVERSIBLE
deleteAccount.permanentText: Once you delete your account, there is no way to recover your data. This is not a temporary deactivation.
deleteAccount.dataDeletedHeading: The following data will be permanently deleted:

dataList.profile: Your user profile and account settings
dataList.workDays: All work days and weekly pay data (every week you've tracked)
dataList.vanHires: All van hire records and deposit information
dataList.mileage: Mileage tracking and pay rate history
dataList.auth: Your authentication credentials (you will be logged out)

alternatives.stopUsing: You can simply stop using the app without deleting your account
alternatives.clearWeeks: You can clear individual weeks if you want to start fresh
alternatives.resetRates: You can reset your pay rates in Settings if they've changed

deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Final confirmation step for account deletion
deleteAccount.lastChance: Last chance: Enter your credentials to permanently delete your account
deleteAccount.passwordHelp: We need to verify your identity before deletion
deleteAccount.finalWarning: After clicking "Delete My Account Forever", your data will be immediately and permanently deleted. You will be logged out and cannot undo this action.
